description.value:
Requirements Your Domain Convocation is active and you and your convocator are within line of effect of each other.

Your convocator unleashes the fury of your pactbound domain. Creatures within your convocator's Domain Convocation aura must make a Reflex save or take 6d6 damage of the type of your Primary Domain. Creatures who take damage also suffer from your Primary Domain’s associated condition. If they would be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, they cannot reduce the Frightened condition below 1 while they can detect your convocator’s presence.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage and suffers the condition for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes full damage and suffers the condition for 3 rounds.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and suffers double the condition value for 3 rounds.

If your domain convocation aura’s radius has increased, you can reduce its radius by 10-foot increments, to a minimum to a 20-foot burst.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 2d6.

system.requirements: Your Domain Convocation is active and you and your convocator are within line of effect of each other.
